description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM platform, specifically for managing search filter parameters related to email subscribers. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties and methods for filtering by enabled status and IDs, with a default sort field set to 'emailSubscriber.name'.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for specifying search filters for email subscribers, including filtering by enabled status and IDs, and setting sorting fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'emailSubscriber.name'.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns the current enabled filter value, which can be true, false, or null.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled filter value based on input.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the list of IDs to filter email subscribers by.

methods.name: setIds
methods.description: Sets the list of IDs to filter email subscribers.
